TUR.scope: Turkey 1990 player data sheet (SBB, IMF, OECD, TCMB, World Bank): central budget $25.08B revenue, $29.54B expenditure, at ~2,609 TL per US$. Income/profit tax split and the unclassified spending residual from historical 1990 consolidated-budget data.

mechs.name: Income tax (direct taxes on income)
mechs.note: Direct taxes $8.66B (22.60tn TL, OECD); personal share 80% from historical 1990 income vs corporate tax. 25-50% progressive brackets (GIB).

mechs.name: Corporate tax
mechs.note: Direct taxes $8.66B, corporate share 20% (historical). 46% statutory rate, 49.2% with surcharges (OECD).

mechs.name: Domestic goods and services tax (KDV / VAT)
mechs.note: $7.40B (19.30tn TL, OECD). 10% standard rate, 1-5% reduced, 15% luxury (Official Gazette).
